summary: This class explores the minhag of performing hakafot with the Sefer Torah on Simhat Torah and Shemini Atzeret. It details the origins of this custom from the Mekubalim of Safed and explains the specific practice in Aleppo of performing seven sets of seven hakafot.
subjects: Rabbi Chaim Cohen of Aram Soba
questions: How many times should one perform hakafot on Simhat Torah?
Where did the custom of doing hakafot originate?
How did the community in Aleppo perform hakafot?
Are there still synagogues today that perform hakafot on Shemini Atzeret?
